mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in the 3-month Treasury yield (measured by GDPC1) indicates a flattening yield curve, which lowers discount rates and increases present value of expected equity cash flows, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC > 0.05 over any 60-day rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in flattening periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the 3-month Treasury yield (measured by GDPC1) signals tightening financial conditions, which raises discount rates and compresses expected equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC > 0.05 over any 20-day rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in rising-yield periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in monthly employment (PAYEMS) suggests a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC > 0.05 over any 5-day rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in strengthening-labor periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in monthly employment (PAYEMS) indicates weakening labor demand, which raises uncertainty and compresses earnings expectations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC > 0.05 over any 20-day rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in weakening-labor periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the monthly industrial production index (INDPRO) signals softening supply-side constraints, which lowers input costs and improves corporate profit margins, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC > 0.05 over any 60-day rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in softening-supply periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the monthly industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates tightening supply-side constraints, which raises production costs and compresses margins, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC > 0.05 over any 20-day rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in tightening-supply periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation index signals a shift toward higher expected returns, which compresses equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC > 0.05 over any 20-day rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in rising-inflation periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation index indicates falling inflation expectations, which lowers discount rates and increases equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC > 0.05 over any 60-day rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in falling-inflation periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
